title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Have you decided who you’re going draft yet
What about now, have you decided
Can you explain to me why you guys announced Torkelson at third base?
Do you really think he is going to be 3B in future? He’s never even played there in college or other leagues
I just don’t get it lol
It doesn’t really matter, right? So why not just announce him as 1B

Our guys feel he has a good chance of playing there. He is Athletic enough. I know you don’t get it but if it works it is a good plan as we move forward. If not no harm no foul Don’t quote me. This is for your info. Our top analyst and top scout feel this is a good move.
I gotta go. A little busy following this
